decision: 10 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 4 for the 12 month period).
fact: Car 81 caused a collision with Car 43 before turn 6.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. The driver of Car 81 misjudged the cars in front, braked too late and ran into the back of Car 43 on the approach to Turn 6. The Stewards determine that the driver of Car 81 was wholly at fault and caused the collision.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 81 Causing A Collision
to: The Team Manager, McLaren Formula 1 Team
